title: Dell fixes critical command-injection flaws in Enterprise SONiC Distribution in 4.6.1
summary: Dell's advisory DSA-2026-451, released 19 November, rates the update critical for Dell Enterprise SONiC Distribution versions prior to 4.6.1. CVE-2026-103788 (CVSS 9.6) is an OS command injection that Dell says an unauthenticated adjacent-network attacker may use for command execution; CVE-2026-103782 (CVSS 9.9) is an argument injection. Dell does not say any of the flaws has been exploited.
plain: Dell says its Enterprise SONiC network-switch software before 4.6.1 has critical flaws that could allow command execution. Dell's page does not say they are being exploited.
exec: Dell rates critical flaws in its Enterprise SONiC switch software; versions before 4.6.1 are affected.
action: Dell advises upgrading Dell Enterprise SONiC Distribution to version 4.6.1, as set out in advisory DSA-2026-451.
geo_basis: Dell's headquarters; the advisory gives no victim location

validation.note: Dell's own advisory read, plus Cyber Security News.
